main_body: bare gothic tree trunk and branches with perched crows
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat 2D front silhouette/cutout. Branches are cut off horizontally at row 0 and vertically on the right edge, and the base at rows 60-62 is a flat horizontal bar with no 3D root spread or top surface.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, organic root structure and 5-6 step bark shading of the Beodeul trees, the candidate has a heavy near-black outline around a simple 3-step banded trunk, flat-filled branches cut off at the tile borders, and a flat slab base instead of textured roots.
